full_version.description: Information about the installed PostgreSQL version, including the version number, system architecture, utilized compiler, and operating system

pg_config.description: Configuration parameters of the currently installed PostgreSQL version

pg_settings.description: Configuration settings of the PostgreSQL server

replication.description: Replication configuration and current state collected after the workload in benchmark mode, or during read-only collection. This is a snapshot, not a history of topology or per-transaction settings during the run.

replication_mode.description: Configured standby selection, current sender/slot counts and collector session context. A disabled synchronous policy does not imply that asynchronous replication is present. Session or transaction SET commands in a custom workload may override this session default. NULL statistics mean insufficient visibility.

replication_settings.description: Effective replication settings in the collector session, units, source and pending restart state. Only settings available on this PostgreSQL version are listed. Connection strings and passwords are excluded.

replication_commit_overrides.description: ALTER ROLE / ALTER DATABASE defaults across the cluster, with applicability to the collector role and database. Role-in-database overrides take precedence over role defaults, which take precedence over database defaults. Session and transaction overrides are not captured.
replication_commit_overrides.empty_message: No permanent synchronous_commit overrides for roles or databases.

replication_senders.description: Physical and logical WAL senders, slot association, sync/quorum/async state, WAL positions and lag at collection time. A physical sender may also be a backup/WAL consumer. NULL lag is unknown, not zero; these are not benchmark-period averages. reply_time is available from PostgreSQL 12.
replication_senders.empty_message: No connected replication senders at collection time. This does not rule out configured or disconnected consumers.

replication_slots.description: Cluster-wide physical/logical slots, activity and xmin horizons. wal_distance_bytes is the WAL distance to restart_lsn, not measured disk usage; distances overlap and must not be summed. Optional fields are NULL when unavailable or unknown: WAL status/safe size from PG13, two_phase from PG14, conflicting from PG16, inactive/invalidation/failover/synced fields from PG17.
replication_slots.empty_message: No replication slots on this server. Replication can operate without slots.

replication_receiver.description: Incoming physical replication and receive/replay positions on a standby. Sender address columns depend on the PostgreSQL version. Connection strings and passwords are excluded. This view does not describe incoming logical subscriptions.
replication_receiver.empty_message: No active physical WAL receiver on this server. A primary normally has none; a standby can use archive recovery or have a disconnected receiver.

replication_subscriptions.header: Logical subscriptions in the collected database
replication_subscriptions.description: Configured incoming logical subscriptions, their worker commit policy and current worker count. Does not include subscriptions in other databases. Connection strings and passwords are excluded.
replication_subscriptions.empty_message: No logical subscriptions in the collected database.
